title: Restore musl release compilation without weakening workspace promotion
intent: Use the Linux renameat2 syscall across libc implementations, preserve atomic no-replace behavior, and add native musl CI for both published Linux architectures.
proof_hooks: GitHub Actions musl build and no-replace publication regressions on x86_64 and aarch64
stop_conditions: No overwriting fallback, release publication, merge, deployment, credentials, or system security changes

spec_reviews.reason: Document direct Linux renameat2 syscall, atomic non-overwrite invariants, fail-closed behavior, and two-architecture musl CI.
No public CLI or data contract changes; Linux kernel primitive keeps the same atomic no-replace interface.
No-replace promotion still fails closed without changing permissions, custody checks, or authorization. Existing security contract is preserved.
